title.en: Planned power outage: Kibuli, Central Kampala
title.lg: Amasannyalaze gagenda kuzikizibwa: Kibuli, Kampala wakati
title.sw: Kukatika kwa umeme kulikopangwa: Kibuli, Kampala ya Kati

description.en: UMEME will switch off power in Kibuli parish on 25 September 2026, 6am to 6pm, for line maintenance. Charge phones early. Fallen wires: call 112.
description.lg: UMEME egenda kuzikiza amasannyalaze mu muluka gwa Kibuli nga 25 September 2026, okuva ku ssaawa 12 ez'oku makya okutu ku ssaawa 12 ez'olweggulo, olw'okuddaabiriza waya. Sasula simu zo mangu. Waya bw'egwa: kubira 112.
description.sw: UMEME itazima umeme katika parishi ya Kibuli tarehe 25 Septemba 2026, saa 12 asubuhi hadi saa 12 jioni, kwa matengenezo. Chaji simu mapema. Waya ikianguka: pigia 112.

title.en: Jinja Road partial closure: Nakawa works
title.lg: Oluguudo lwa Jinja lugenda kuggalwaako: emirimu e Nakawa
title.sw: Kufungwa kwa sehemu ya Barabara ya Jinja: kazi Nakawa

description.en: KCCA closes one lane of Jinja Road near Nakawa from 28 September 2026 for resurfacing. Use the marked diversion. Expect delays. Works run 8am to 5pm daily.
description.lg: KCCA egenda kuggala olutundu lumu olw'oluguudo lwa Jinja okumpi ne Nakawa okuva nga 28 September 2026 olw'okuluddaabiriza. Kozesa ekkubo eritegedde. Suubira okukwatibwa. Emirimu gikolebwa okuva ku ssaawa 2 ez'oku makya okutu ku ssaawa 11 ez'olweggulo buli lunaku.
description.sw: KCCA itafunga njia moja ya Barabara ya Jinja karibu na Nakawa kuanzia 28 Septemba 2026 kwa ukarabati. Tumia mchepuko ulioashiriwa. Tarajia kuchelewa. Kazi hufanyika saa 2 asubuhi hadi saa 11 jioni kila siku.

description.en: NWSC shuts supply in Nakisunga sub-county on 26 September 2026, 8am to 4pm, to repair a burst main. Store water early. Repairs are free.
description.lg: NWSC egenda kuggala amazzi mu ggombolola y'e Nakisunga nga 26 September 2026, okuva ku ssaawa 2 ez'oku makya okutu ku ssaawa 10 ez'olweggulo, okuddaabiriza ppayipu ennene eyameneka. Tegeka amazzi mangu. Okuddaabiriza kwa bwereere.
description.sw: NWSC itafunga usambazaji tarafa ya Nakisunga tarehe 26 Septemba 2026, saa 2 asubuhi hadi saa 10 jioni, kurekebisha bomba kuu lililopasuka. Hifadhi maji mapema. Ukarabati ni bure.

title.lg: Olunaku lw'okuyonja ekitundu: akatale k'e Kyampisi
title.sw: Siku ya usafi ya jamii: soko la Kyampisi

description.en: Kyampisi parish cleanup at the market on 3 October 2026 from 7am. Bring a rake or broom. LC2 provides bags and gloves. All traders welcome.
description.lg: Okuyonja omuluka gwa Kyampisi ku katale nga 3 October 2026 okuva ku ssaawa 1 ez'oku makya. Leeta enkumbi oba omweyo. LC2 ewa ensawo ne gulovusi. Abasuubuzi bonna batu invite.
description.sw: Usafi wa parishi ya Kyampisi sokoni tarehe 3 Oktoba 2026 kuanzia saa 1 asubuhi. Leta reki au ufagio. LC2 hutoa mifuko na glavu. Wafanyabiashara wote mwakaribishwa.

title.en: Free national ID mass enrollment starts October
title.lg: Okuwandiisa ID ey'eggwanga kwa bwereere kutandika mu October
title.sw: Usajili wa halaiki wa vitambulisho vya taifa bure unaanza Oktoba

description.en: NIRA opens free mass ID enrollment countrywide in October 2026. Carry your LC1 letter. First registration is free. Ignore agents asking for money.
description.lg: NIRA eggulawo okuwandiisa ID ey'eggwanga kwa bwereere eggwanga lyonna mu October 2026. Twala ebbaluwa yo ya LC1. Okuwandiisa okusooka kwa bwereere. Buuza bakayaaya abasaba ssente.
description.sw: NIRA inafungua usajili wa halaiki wa vitambulisho bure nchi nzima Oktoba 2026. Beba barua yako ya LC1. Usajili wa kwanza ni bure. Wapuuzie mawakala wanaodai pesa.
